nodes.label: BuffData.ts
nodes.summary: Central buff/debuff definition system for Voxel Blade. Defines all buff types (Rage, Regen, Reinforce, Tailwind, etc.) and debuffs (Slowness, Despair, Bleed, Burn, Poison, etc.) with their visual styling, potency scaling, and dynamic descriptions. Provides factories for perk-granted buffs, item/rune/weapon-art buff assignments, potency/duration modifiers (Gladiatorial Rage, Mage Rage, Fury, Wind Walker, etc.), and an assembly pipeline that applies transformations (True Balance debuff→buff conversion, Tailwind→Whirlwind, Cauterize Burn→Singed conversion, Toxin Transfer duration inheritance) to produce the final active buff list for a build.

nodes.label: BuffDefinition
nodes.summary: Interface defining a buff/debuff: name, color, description, effect per tenth potency, stat key, whether it's a debuff/neutral, and optional dynamic description generator.

nodes.label: GrantedBuff
nodes.summary: Interface for a concrete buff instance granted to a build: buffName, potency, duration, condition, source name/type, self-debuff flag, and burn mode (dot/singed).

nodes.label: ActiveBuffsBuildInput
nodes.summary: Input interface for assembling active buffs from a full build: all equipment slots, race, selected weapon art, and potions.

nodes.label: BuffPotencyModifier
nodes.summary: Interface for per-buff modifiers: buffName, potency per stack, label, optional rune filter and duration multiplier formula.

nodes.label: GenericDebuffModifier
nodes.summary: Interface for generic debuff modifiers: perkName, potency multiplier per stack, flat potency bonus, duration multiplier per stack.

nodes.label: BUFF_DEFS
nodes.summary: Master record of all buff/debuff definitions. Contains ~40 entries covering buffs (Rage, Regen, Reinforce, Tailwind, Whirlwind, Critical Boost, Hexigen, Inspired, Perfection, Air Pressure, Magic Reinforce, Luminescent, Cloudpush, Cinderpull, Draconic Infusion, Lightning Cloak, Bloodlust, Glyph Conduit, Queens Power), debuffs (Slowness, Despair, Weakness, Bleed, Burn, Singed, Poison, Frostbite, Sticky + variants, Shatter, Electrical Rend, Hypnotized, Taunt, Anti Heal, Wound, Runic Blades), neutral effects (Last Croak, Tongue Shot, Beenades, Ancient Shield, Quickdraw, Exhaust, Converted Energy, Hex Shield, Steam Buildup, Bursting, Arrows, Sun Blessed), and Minion Absorbed. Each entry defines color, description, effect scaling, and optional dynamic description.

nodes.label: BASIC_DEBUFF_POOL
nodes.summary: Array of 6 basic debuffs (Bleed, Burn, Poison, Shatter, Slowness, Weakness) with standard potency/duration values, used for random debuff application from various sources.

properties.type: Array<{ buffName: string; potency: number; duration: number }>

nodes.label: getWeaponArtBuffs
nodes.summary: Returns GrantedBuff[] for a given weapon art name. Supports Warrior Stomp (Rage+Taunt), Javelin (Slowness), Lightning Cloak, and Cursed Ground (Weakness + random basic debuff).

nodes.label: getTrueBalanceBuffs
nodes.summary: Converts active debuffs into corresponding buffs via the True Balance perk mapping (e.g., Bleed→Regen, Slowness→Tailwind, Shatter→Reinforce, Weakness→Rage, Despair→Inspired). Groups by target buff name, takes max potency/duration.

nodes.label: applyBuffPerkModifiers
nodes.summary: Core modifier pipeline applied to a list of GrantedBuff[]: applies specific buff modifiers (Gladiatorial Rage, Mage Rage, Oceans Rage, Slayer Rage, Fury, Wind Walker, Iron Slayer, Potion Chugger, Bounce Momentum), Bastion Bless bonus, Trickster reflection (Despair only), generic debuff modifiers (Endless Despair, Stored Corruption), Contained multiplier, and Dark One duration multiplier. Handles Warding debuff multiplier for Despair+Trickster special case.

nodes.label: applyToxinTransferDuration
nodes.summary: Applies Toxin Transfer perk: sets Poison debuff duration from Toxin Transfer source to the maximum self-Poison duration plus a constant extra duration.

nodes.label: convertTailwindToWhirlwind
nodes.summary: When Whirlwind perk is active, converts all Tailwind buffs to Whirlwind buffs (different effect scaling) and adds a Bleed debuff on WA/Rune use.

nodes.label: getBuffDescription
nodes.summary: Returns formatted description string for a buff, using dynamicDescription if available, with special formatting for Weakness (damage reduction %), Shatter (armor loss), Anti Heal (healing reduction %), and generic x% substitution with calculated effect value.

nodes.label: getPerkBuffs
nodes.summary: Iterates all perks with positive amounts, invokes the corresponding PerkBuffFactory from PERK_BUFFS, and returns the combined list of GrantedBuff[] with rounded durations.

nodes.label: getActiveBuildBuffs
nodes.summary: Collects all item-sourced buffs from 9 equipment slots (rune, ring, infusion ring, helmet, chestplate, leggings, weapon blade/handle, monk glove) plus race buffs, using the BUFFS_BY_ITEM_SOURCE lookup index.

parameters: build: { rune, ring, infusionRing, helmet, chestplate, leggings, weaponBlade, weaponHandle, monkGlove, race? }

nodes.label: applyCauterizeConversion
nodes.summary: When Cauterize perk is active (and Cursed Flames is not), converts all enemy-applied Burn debuffs to singed mode (burst on application instead of DoT).

nodes.label: getBurnApplicationCount
nodes.summary: Counts the number of Burn application entries in a buff list, used to multiply Cauterize/Singed single-burst damage.

nodes.label: assembleActiveBuffs
nodes.summary: Full assembly pipeline for the active buff list: collects item buffs from equipment + potions, perk buffs, weapon art buffs, runs applyBuffPerkModifiers, convertTailwindToWhirlwind, and applyCauterizeConversion in sequence. Used by the build engine and UI.

nodes.label: calcBuffEffect
nodes.summary: Calculates the numeric effect value of a buff given its name and potency: value = effectPerTenthPotency × potency × 10. Returns value, unit ('%' or 'flat'), and a label string.

nodes.label: formatPerkDescription
nodes.summary: Formats a perk description by substituting x% with the computed potency percentage based on the perk amount.

nodes.label: ITEM_BUFF_MAP
nodes.summary: Array of GrantedBuff[] mapping items/runes/potions to buffs they grant. Covers Rage Rune, Toad Slam, Bounce Rune, Beenade Rune, Ancient Cleric, Boostshroom, Sporeling Toss, Thunderous Charge, Winter Woof, Glacial Snapper, Cacitrops, Brainblast, Hex Web, Fireball, False Sun, Snoeball, Rage Potion, Poison Potion.

nodes.label: PERK_BUFFS
nodes.summary: Record of PerkBuffFactory functions for ~40+ perks. Each factory receives perk amount and allPerks map, returns GrantedBuff[]. Covers Perfection, Bounce Momentum, Bastion Ballista, Toadzerker, Iron Bounce, Springblast, Spring Step/Powered, Wrathful Crits, Blood Lust, Emergency Exit, Blessing, Luminescent Fervor, Propelling Fun, Smoldering, Bomber Spirit, Cursed Experiment, Royal Parry, Beastial Rage, Vassals Croak, Iron Slayer, Bastion Bless, Barbskin, Cursed Bark, Aggressive Personality, Air Pressure, Apollo Boost, Valor, Channeled Weapon, Gladiatorial Rage, Minion Absorption, Glyph Conduit, Roaring Heads, Hex Shield, Honey Arts, Sharp Claws, Wild Bolt, Heat Drill, Storm Rend, Erosion, Quickdraw, Sickness, Exhaust, Tailwind, Volatile Shell, Spore Burst, Toxin Transfer, Grounded Despair, Steam Charge/Powered, Queen Bumblz, Queens Power, Frozen Waste, Icestorm, Swift Guard, Runic Winds, Croakernaut.

nodes.label: WEAPON_ART_BUFF_MAP
nodes.summary: Record mapping weapon art names to GrantedBuff[] for Warrior Stomp, Javelin, Lightning Cloak, and Cursed Ground.

nodes.label: TRUE_BALANCE_DEBUFF_MAP
nodes.summary: Mapping of 10 debuff types to their True Balance conversion target buffs (e.g., Bleed→Regen, Shatter→Reinforce, Weakness→Rage, Despair→Inspired) with per-amount potency/duration functions.

nodes.label: BUFF_POTENCY_MODIFIERS
nodes.summary: Array of BuffPotencyModifier for per-buff modifications: Bounce (Bounce Momentum), Rage (Gladiatorial, Mage, Oceans, Slayer, Iron Slayer, Fury, Potion Chugger), Weakness (Slayer), Tailwind (Tailwind perk, Wind Walker), Bleed (Slow Leak), Poison (Potion Chugger).

nodes.label: GENERIC_DEBUFF_MODIFIERS
nodes.summary: Array of GenericDebuffModifier for Endless Despair (potency multiplier, flat bonus, duration multiplier per stack) and Stored Corruption (duration multiplier per stack).

nodes.label: RACE_BUFF_MAP
nodes.summary: Record mapping race names to GrantedBuff[]: BUNIKIN (Critical Boost on dodge), DARK ELF (random basic debuff on hit).

nodes.label: formatDamageTypes
nodes.summary: Helper that formats a list of damage type strings into readable English (e.g., ['physical'] → 'physical', ['physical', 'water'] → 'physical and water', ['physical', 'magic', 'fire'] → 'physical, magic and fire').

nodes.label: durationMultFromStack
nodes.summary: Factory that returns a duration multiplier function: (stacks) => base + perStack * stacks.

nodes.label: getSpecificBuffModifiers
nodes.summary: Looks up MODIFIERS_BY_BUFF for the given buff, applies matching modifier stacks (skipping self-debuffs unless Contained/Despair), returns cumulative bonus potency and duration multiplier.

nodes.label: getBastionBlessBonus
nodes.summary: Calculates bonus potency from Bastion Bless perk for non-debuff, non-neutral, non-capped buffs.

nodes.label: getGenericDebuffModifiers
nodes.summary: Applies Endless Despair and Stored Corruption modifiers to debuffs, skipping self-debuffs (except Despair). Returns potency multiplier, flat bonus, and duration multiplier.

nodes.label: getTricksterReflection
nodes.summary: Calculates Trickster reflection bonus for Despair self-debuffs: (tricksterStacks / 10) * (1 + warding-adjusted base potency). Handles Warding multiplier to ensure correct post-hoc multiplication.

nodes.label: calcPotencyPercent
nodes.summary: Internal function computing a percentage value from a perk amount using a nonlinear formula involving power and multiplicative scaling.

nodes.label: MODIFIERS_BY_BUFF
nodes.summary: Index of BUFF_POTENCY_MODIFIERS grouped by buffName for O(1) lookup.

nodes.label: BUFFS_BY_ITEM_SOURCE
nodes.summary: Index of ITEM_BUFF_MAP grouped by sourceName for O(1) lookup.

edges.label: reads from TRUE_BALANCE_DEBUFF_MAP for buff conversion mapping
checks BUFF_DEFS for isSelfDebuff flag filtering
uses MODIFIERS_BY_BUFF for specific buff modifiers
calls getWeaponArtBuffs for weapon art buffs
calls getBastionBlessBonus for Bastion Bless bonus
calls getTricksterReflection for Trickster Despair bonus
calls getGenericDebuffModifiers for generic debuff modifiers
calls calcBuffEffect to compute numeric effect value
uses BUFFS_BY_ITEM_SOURCE index for item lookup
reads WEAPON_ART_BUFF_MAP for weapon art buffs
